(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* The downhole telemetry subsystem transmits 6 independent sensor triplets across the 3,500m
   armored umbilical. Each triplet is evaluated using a rigorous 2oo3 voting architecture with
   disparity tracking, rogue sensor isolation, autonomous degradation to 1oo2, and fail-safe fallback. *)

(* --- 2.1 Downhole Suction Pressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
(* Disparity threshold: 4.5 bar, Persistence filter: 0.150 seconds *)
bSuct_Fault_PT1 := FALSE;
bSuct_Fault_PT2 := FALSE;
bSuct_Fault_PT3 := FALSE;

rSuct_Diff12 := ABS(rSuctionPressure_PT1 - rSuctionPressure_PT2);
rSuct_Diff23 := ABS(rSuctionPressure_PT2 - rSuctionPressure_PT3);
rSuct_Diff13 := ABS(rSuctionPressure_PT1 - rSuctionPressure_PT3);

IF rSuct_Diff12 > 4.5 THEN
    rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    IF rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 > c_rScanTimeSeconds THEN
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 - c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    ELSE
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rSuct_Diff23 > 4.5 THEN
    rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    IF rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 > c_rScanTimeSeconds THEN
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 - c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    ELSE
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rSuct_Diff13 > 4.5 THEN
    rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    IF rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 > c_rScanTimeSeconds THEN
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 := rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 - c_rScanTimeSeconds;
    ELSE
        rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF (rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 > 0.150) AND (rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 > 0.150) THEN
    bSuct_Fault_PT1 := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rSuct_DisparityAccum_1 > 0.150) AND (rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 > 0.150) THEN
    bSuct_Fault_PT2 := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rSuct_DisparityAccum_2 > 0.150) AND (rSuct_DisparityAccum_3 > 0.150) THEN
    bSuct_Fault_PT3 := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Sensor range bounds check [0.0 bar to 450.0 bar] *)
IF (rSuctionPressure_PT1 < 0.0) OR (rSuctionPressure_PT1 > 450.0) THEN bSuct_Fault_PT1 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rSuctionPressure_PT2 < 0.0) OR (rSuctionPressure_PT2 > 450.0) THEN bSuct_Fault_PT2 := TRUE; END_IF;
IF (rSuctionPressure_PT3 < 0.0) OR (rSuctionPressure_PT3 > 450.0) THEN bSuct_Fault_PT3 := TRUE; END_IF;

IF NOT bSuct_Fault_PT1 AND NOT bSuct_Fault_PT2 AND NOT bSuct_Fault_PT3 THEN
    (* All 3 Healthy: Compute Median *)
    IF ((rSuctionPressure_PT1 >= rSuctionPressure_PT2) AND (rSuctionPressure_PT1 <= rSuctionPressure_PT3)) OR
       ((rSuctionPressure_PT1 <= rSuctionPressure_PT2) AND (rSuctionPressure_PT1 >= rSuctionPressure_PT3)) THEN
        rVotedSuctionPress := rSuctionPressure_PT1;
    ELSIF ((rSuctionPressure_PT2 >= rSuctionPressure_PT1) AND (rSuctionPressure_PT2 <= rSuctionPressure_PT3)) OR
          ((rSuctionPressure_PT2 <= rSuctionPressure_PT1) AND (rSuctionPressure_PT2 >= rSuctionPressure_PT3)) THEN
        rVotedSuctionPress := rSuctionPressure_PT2;
    ELSE
        rVotedSuctionPress := rSuctionPressure_PT3;
    END_IF;
    bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bSuct_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bSuct_Fault_PT1 AND NOT bSuct_Fault_PT2 AND NOT bSuct_Fault_PT3 THEN
    rVotedSuctionPress := (rSuctionPressure_PT2 + rSuctionPressure_PT3) * 0.5;
    bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bSuct_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bSuct_Fault_PT2 AND NOT bSuct_Fault_PT1 AND NOT bSuct_Fault_PT3 THEN
    rVotedSuctionPress := (rSuctionPressure_PT1 + rSuctionPressure_PT3) * 0.5;
    bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bSuct_Failed_Total := FALSE;

          ((rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 <= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1) AND (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 >= rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3)) THEN
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2;
    ELSE
        rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3;
    END_IF;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bBarr_Fault_DPT1 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT2 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT3 THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2 + rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3) * 0.5;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bBarr_Fault_DPT2 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT1 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT3 THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 + rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT3) * 0.5;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSIF bBarr_Fault_DPT3 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT1 AND NOT bBarr_Fault_DPT2 THEN
    rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int := (rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT1 + rBarrierDiffPressure_DPT2) * 0.5;
    bBarr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    bBarr_Failed_Total := FALSE;
ELSE
    bBarr_Failed_Total := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Total Barrier Delta-P TMR Failure *)
END_IF;

rVotedBarrierDiffPress := rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int;

(* --- 2.7 Downhole Bearing Housing Tri-Axial Vibration Velocity & Crest Factor --- *)
(* Composite Vibration Magnitude: sqrt(Vx^2 + Vy^2 + Vz^2) *)
rCompositeVibrationRMS := SQRT((rPumpVibration_X * rPumpVibration_X) +
                               (rPumpVibration_Y * rPumpVibration_Y) +
                               (rPumpVibration_Z * rPumpVibration_Z));

bDegradedSensorMode := bSuct_Degraded_1oo2 OR bDisc_Degraded_1oo2 OR
                       bSuctT_Degraded_1oo2 OR bMotT_Degraded_1oo2 OR
                       bFlow_Degraded_1oo2 OR bBarr_Degraded_1oo2;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 HIGH-ENTHALPY GEOTHERMAL BRINE FLASHING & NPSH THERMODYNAMICS                        *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Real-time thermodynamic model calculating in-situ hypersaline brine density, steam bubble
   point saturation pressure, non-condensable gas partial pressure, Net Positive Suction Head
   Available (NPSHA), required NPSH (NPSHR), and two-phase drift-flux vapor quality. *)

(* In-situ water density: Polynomial approximation for pure water at high temp (T: 20..320 deg C)
   rho_w(T) = 1000.0 - 0.0195 * (T - 20) - 0.00345 * (T - 20)^2 [kg/m3] *)
rBaseWaterDensity := 1000.0 - 0.0195 * (rVotedSuctionTemp - 20.0) - 0.00345 * (rVotedSuctionTemp - 20.0) * (rVotedSuctionTemp - 20.0);
IF rBaseWaterDensity < 700.0 THEN rBaseWaterDensity := 700.0; END_IF;

(* Brine density elevation due to Total Dissolved Solids (TDS [g/L]):
   Delta_rho_salinity = TDS * 0.735 kg/m3 per g/L *)
rSalinityDensityDelta := rBrineSalinityTDS * 0.735;
rBrineMixtureDensity := rBaseWaterDensity + rSalinityDensityDelta;

(* Pure water vapor saturation pressure: Antoine-Clapeyron parameterization [bar]
   log10(P_sat_pure) = 5.20389 - 1733.926 / (T + 233.665) *)
rTmp1 := 5.20389 - (1733.926 / (rVotedSuctionTemp + 233.665));
rPureWaterSatPress := EXPT(10.0, rTmp1);

(* Boiling Point Elevation & Raoult Salinity Depression of Vapor Pressure:
   P_sat_brine = P_sat_pure * (1.0 - 0.000537 * TDS) *)
rTmp2 := 1.0 - (0.000537 * rBrineSalinityTDS);
IF rTmp2 < 0.70 THEN rTmp2 := 0.70; END_IF;
rBrineSaturationPressure := rPureWaterSatPress * rTmp2;

(* Non-Condensable Gas (CO2 / H2S) Outgassing Partial Pressure via Henry's Law:
   K_H_CO2(280 deg C) ~ 4500 bar / mol_frac. Linearized partial pressure calculation *)
rNCGPartialPressure := rNCGMassFraction * 142.5;
rTotalBubblePointPress := rBrineSaturationPressure + rNCGPartialPressure;

(* Fluid linear velocity through first-stage impeller suction eye: v = Q / A *)
(* Q in [m3/h] converted to [m3/s]: Q / 3600.0 *)
rImpellerEyeVelocity := (rVotedBrineFlow / 3600.0) / c_rImpellerEyeArea;

(* Dynamic velocity head term: v^2 / (2 * g) [m] *)
rDynamicVelocityHead := (rImpellerEyeVelocity * rImpellerEyeVelocity) / (2.0 * c_rGravityAcc);

(* Suction bell and casing inlet frictional head loss: h_loss = K_loss * v^2 / 2g *)
rEyeFrictionalHeadLoss := 0.35 * rDynamicVelocityHead;

(* Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHA) at first impeller eye:
   NPSHA = 100,000 * (P_suct - P_bubble) / (rho * g) + v^2/2g - h_loss *)
rCalculatedNPSHA_Int := ((100000.0 * (rVotedSuctionPress - rTotalBubblePointPress)) /
                         (rBrineMixtureDensity * c_rGravityAcc)) +
                         rDynamicVelocityHead - rEyeFrictionalHeadLoss;
rCalculatedNPSHA := rCalculatedNPSHA_Int;

(* Net Positive Suction Head Required (NPSHR) scaling with speed and flow:
   NPSHR = NPSHR_bep * (N / N_nom)^2 + K_q * (Q / Q_nom)^2 *)
rSpeedRatio := rPumpSpeedFeedback / c_rRatedMotorSpeed;
IF rSpeedRatio < 0.20 THEN rSpeedRatio := 0.20; END_IF;

rFlowRatio := rVotedBrineFlow / c_rPumpBestEfficiencyFlow;
IF rFlowRatio < 0.10 THEN rFlowRatio := 0.10; END_IF;

rCalculatedNPSHR_Int := (8.5 * (rSpeedRatio * rSpeedRatio)) + (6.2 * (rFlowRatio * rFlowRatio));
rCalculatedNPSHR := rCalculatedNPSHR_Int;

(* Cavitation Safety Index Margin: C_margin = NPSHA / NPSHR *)
IF rCalculatedNPSHR_Int > 0.1 THEN
    rCavitationIndexMargin := rCalculatedNPSHA_Int / rCalculatedNPSHR_Int;
ELSE
    rCavitationIndexMargin := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Two-Phase Flashing Expansion & Vapor Void Fraction Estimation (Drift-Flux Model):
   If P_suct < P_bubble, flashing occurs. Mass vapor quality x = (h - h_L) / h_LV *)
IF rVotedSuctionPress < rTotalBubblePointPress THEN
    (* Thermodynamic flash quality approximation *)
    rTmp3 := (rTotalBubblePointPress - rVotedSuctionPress) / rTotalBubblePointPress;
    IF rTmp3 > 0.25 THEN rTmp3 := 0.25; END_IF;
    rVaporQuality_x := rTmp3 * 0.145;

    (* Vapor density at saturation pressure: Ideal gas approximation rho_v = P / (R_steam * T) *)
    rVaporDensity := (rTotalBubblePointPress * 100000.0) / (461.5 * (rVotedSuctionTemp + 273.15));
    IF rVaporDensity < 0.5 THEN rVaporDensity := 0.5; END_IF;

    (* Volumetric void fraction alpha = (1 + ((1-x)/x) * (rho_v / rho_L) * S)^(-1) *)
    IF rVaporQuality_x > 0.0001 THEN
        rTmp4 := 1.0 + (((1.0 - rVaporQuality_x) / rVaporQuality_x) *
                        (rVaporDensity / rBrineMixtureDensity) * rSlipRatio_S);
        rVoidFraction_alpha := 1.0 / rTmp4;
    ELSE
        rVoidFraction_alpha := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVaporQuality_x := 0.0;
    rVoidFraction_alpha := 0.0;
END_IF;
rTwoPhaseVaporFraction := rVoidFraction_alpha;

(* Head degradation under two-phase flashing: H = H_ideal * (1 - 1.85 * alpha) *)
rTmpA := 1.0 - (1.85 * rVoidFraction_alpha);
IF rTmpA < 0.15 THEN rTmpA := 0.15; END_IF;
rDifferentialHeadDeveloped := (c_rStagesCount * c_rStageBaseHead * (rSpeedRatio * rSpeedRatio)) * rTmpA;

(* Flashing Cavitation Warning & Hard Interlock Evaluation *)
IF rCavitationIndexMargin < c_rMinCavitationMarginWarn THEN
    bCavitationAlarm := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Incipient Cavitation Flashing Warning *)
ELSE
    bCavitationAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rCavitationIndexMargin < c_rMinCavitationMarginTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Critical Cavitation Trip Interlock *)
END_IF;

(* Critical Void Fraction Vapor Locking Interlock *)
IF rVoidFraction_alpha > c_rMaxTwoPhaseVaporTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Severe Two-Phase Vapor Lock Trip *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 DOWNHOLE DRIVE TRAIN TORSIONAL HARMONICS & VSD ACTIVE DAMPING                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-order discrete state observer and dual biquad bandpass filter isolating dynamic shaft
   torsional vibrations across the 3,500m string at resonant poles (14.5 Hz and 32.1 Hz).
   Injects synthetic counter-phase damping torque directly into the VFD torque command loop. *)

(* Biquad Bandpass Filter 1 (Centered at f_res1 = 14.5 Hz, Q = 5.0, Ts = 0.010 s)
   Transfer function discrete bilinear transform coefficients:
   b0 = 0.0835, b1 = 0.0, b2 = -0.0835, a1 = -1.6350, a2 = 0.8330 *)
rTmp1 := (rPumpSpeedFeedback * 0.10471975) - (rVFDOutputFrequency * 6.2831853); (* Delta_omega [rad/s] *)

rBPF1_y := (0.0835 * rTmp1) - (0.0835 * rBPF1_x2) - (-1.6350 * rBPF1_x1) - (0.8330 * rBPF1_x2);
rBPF1_x2 := rBPF1_x1;
rBPF1_x1 := rBPF1_y;

(* Biquad Bandpass Filter 2 (Centered at f_res2 = 32.1 Hz, Q = 6.0, Ts = 0.010 s)
   b0 = 0.0520, b1 = 0.0, b2 = -0.0520, a1 = -1.1240, a2 = 0.8960 *)
rBPF2_y := (0.0520 * rTmp1) - (0.0520 * rBPF2_x2) - (-1.1240 * rBPF2_x1) - (0.8960 * rBPF2_x2);
rBPF2_x2 := rBPF2_x1;
rBPF2_x1 := rBPF2_y;

(* Composite observed torsional twist velocity *)
rTorsionalVelocityTwist := rBPF1_y + (0.65 * rBPF2_y);

(* Active synthetic damping torque injection: T_damp = -K_damp * d(theta)/dt *)
rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int := -34.5 * rTorsionalVelocityTwist;

(* Saturate maximum synthetic damping injection to +/- 15% rated motor torque (Rating: ~3270 N*m) *)
IF rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int > 490.0 THEN
    rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int := 490.0;
ELSIF rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int < -490.0 THEN
    rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int := -490.0;
END_IF;
rActiveDampingTorque := rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int;

(* Dynamic Shaft Angular Twist Deflection integration: d(delta_theta)/dt = omega_twist *)
rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad := rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad + (rTorsionalVelocityTwist * c_rScanTimeSeconds);
(* High-pass wash-out filter on twist angle to eliminate steady-state integration drift *)
rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad := rDynamicShaftDeflectionRad * 0.995;

(* Peak Dynamic Shear Stress Amplitude: tau = (G * r * delta_theta) / L = T_dyn / Wp *)
rPeakShearStress_MPa := (ABS(rTorsionalDampingTorque_Int * 3.8) / c_rShaftPolarModulus) * 1.0E-6;
rEstimatedTorsionalStress := rPeakShearStress_MPa;

(* Detect dominant torsional oscillation frequency *)
IF ABS(rBPF1_y) > ABS(rBPF2_y) THEN
    rTorsionalOscillationFreq := c_rTorsionalResonanceFreq1;
ELSE
    rTorsionalOscillationFreq := c_rTorsionalResonanceFreq2;
END_IF;

(* Torsional Resonance Lock Condition Flag *)
IF (rPeakShearStress_MPa > (c_rMaxTorsionalShearLimit * 0.65)) AND (ABS(rTorsionalVelocityTwist) > 1.85) THEN
    bTorsionalResonanceLock := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Torsional Harmonic Resonance Lock Alert *)
ELSE
    bTorsionalResonanceLock := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rPeakShearStress_MPa > c_rMaxTorsionalShearLimit THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Critical Shaft Shear Fatigue Trip *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 DIELECTRIC BARRIER FLUID EXPANSION PRESSURE REGULATION                                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Regulates the internal dielectric oil overpressure inside the ESP motor protector section.
   Guarantees a positive differential (0.10 to 0.40 bar) above wellbore hydrostatic pressure to
   strictly prevent corrosive, hypersaline brine ingress while protecting shaft seals from blowout. *)

(* Thermal Volumetric Expansion Model for Synthetic Polyol-Ester Oil:
   Delta_V = V_0 * [beta_1 * (T - 20) + beta_2 * (T - 20)^2]
   beta_1 = 8.42E-4 [1/K], beta_2 = 5.20E-7 [1/K^2] *)
rTmp1 := rVotedMotorTemp - 20.0;
IF rTmp1 < 0.0 THEN rTmp1 := 0.0; END_IF;

rThermalExpansionFactor := (c_rDielectricBeta1 * rTmp1) + (c_rDielectricBeta2 * rTmp1 * rTmp1);
rTargetExpandedOilVolume := c_rBaseDielectricVolume * (1.0 + rThermalExpansionFactor);
rBellowsVolumeExpansion := rTargetExpandedOilVolume - c_rBaseDielectricVolume;

(* Expected Bellows Linear Stroke Position: x_bellows = Delta_V / A_bellows *)
rBellowsPositionMeters := (rBellowsVolumeExpansion * 0.001) / c_rBellowsArea;

(* Closed-Loop Differential Pressure Error: e = Delta_P_barrier - Delta_P_target *)
rBarrierDiffError := rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int - c_rBarrierTargetDeltaP;

(* Solenoid Relief Valve Modulation: Proportional-Integral with Anti-Windup *)
IF bBarrierBleedPermissive THEN
    rBarrierIntegralAccum := rBarrierIntegralAccum + (rBarrierDiffError * c_rScanTimeSeconds * 12.5);
    IF rBarrierIntegralAccum > 100.0 THEN
        rBarrierIntegralAccum := 100.0;
    ELSIF rBarrierIntegralAccum < 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierIntegralAccum := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    rBarrierBleedDemand := (45.0 * rBarrierDiffError) + rBarrierIntegralAccum;
    IF rBarrierBleedDemand > 100.0 THEN
        rBarrierBleedDemand := 100.0;
    ELSIF rBarrierBleedDemand < 0.0 THEN
        rBarrierBleedDemand := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBarrierBleedDemand := 0.0;
    rBarrierIntegralAccum := 0.0;
END_IF;
rBarrierFluidBleedValve := rBarrierBleedDemand;

(* Dielectric Barrier Overpressure and Underpressure Interlocks *)
IF (rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int < c_rBarrierMinDeltaPWarn) OR
   (rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int > c_rBarrierMaxDeltaPWarn) THEN
    bBarrierPressureAbnormal := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Barrier Differential Warning *)
ELSE
    bBarrierPressureAbnormal := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int < c_rBarrierMinDeltaPTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: Critical Brine Ingress Hazard Trip *)
END_IF;

IF rVotedBarrierDiffPress_Int > c_rBarrierMaxDeltaPTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Barrier Seal Overpressure Blowout Trip *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 6-STATE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Computes state innovation updates using discrete state-space matrices (A, B, C, D) and
   solves a deterministic Quadratic Programming (QP) optimization for VFD frequency and choke
   commands with anti-windup rate limiting and anti-flashing speed derating. *)

(* --- 6.1 Luenberger / Kalman Filter State Observer Prediction & Innovation --- *)
(* Measured output perturbations: y[1] = P_suct - P_suct_nominal, y[2] = P_disc - P_disc_nominal *)
y1_Meas := rVotedSuctionPress - 350.0;
y2_Meas := rVotedDischargePress - 480.0;

(* Output estimate: y_est = Cd * x_hat *)
y1_Est := (Cd_11 * x1_SuctDev) + (Cd_12 * x2_DiscDev) + (Cd_13 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
          (Cd_14 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Cd_15 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Cd_16 * x6_BarrierDev);

y2_Est := (Cd_21 * x1_SuctDev) + (Cd_22 * x2_DiscDev) + (Cd_23 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
          (Cd_24 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Cd_25 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Cd_26 * x6_BarrierDev);

(* Output innovation: y_innov = y_meas - y_est *)
y1_Innov := y1_Meas - y1_Est;
y2_Innov := y2_Meas - y2_Est;

(* State propagation: x_next = Ad * x_hat + Bd * u + L * y_innov *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_11 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_12 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_11 * y1_Innov) + (L_12 * y2_Innov);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_21 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_22 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_21 * y1_Innov) + (L_22 * y2_Innov);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_31 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_32 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_31 * y1_Innov) + (L_32 * y2_Innov);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_41 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_42 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_41 * y1_Innov) + (L_42 * y2_Innov);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_51 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_52 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_51 * y1_Innov) + (L_52 * y2_Innov);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_SuctDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_DiscDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_VoidFracDev) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_TwistAngDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_TwistVelDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_BarrierDev) +
           (Bd_61 * Delta_u1_opt) + (Bd_62 * Delta_u2_opt) +
           (L_61 * y1_Innov) + (L_62 * y2_Innov);

(* Update state vector registers *)
x1_SuctDev     := x1_Next;
x2_DiscDev     := x2_Next;
x3_VoidFracDev := x3_Next;
x4_TwistAngDev := x4_Next;
x5_TwistVelDev := x5_Next;
x6_BarrierDev  := x6_Next;

(* --- 6.2 Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Programming Solver --- *)
(* Cost Function: J = 0.5 * Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + g^T * Delta_u
   Gradient computation: g = H_grad_x * x_hat - H_ref * ref *)
Grad_1 := (1.250 * x1_SuctDev) + (0.450 * x2_DiscDev) - (1.100 * rRef_SuctionPressDelta);
Grad_2 := (-0.380 * x1_SuctDev) + (0.820 * x2_DiscDev) - (0.950 * rRef_DischargePressDelta);

(* Unconstrained QP step: Delta_u_unc = -H_inv * Gradient *)
Delta_u1_unc := -((HessInv_11 * Grad_1) + (HessInv_12 * Grad_2));
Delta_u2_unc := -((HessInv_21 * Grad_1) + (HessInv_22 * Grad_2));

(* Apply Dynamic Anti-Flashing Speed Derating Factor K_derate:
   If cavitation margin ratio is low, heavily damp positive frequency accelerations *)
IF rCavitationIndexMargin < 1.35 THEN
    rCavitationSpeedDerate := (rCavitationIndexMargin - 1.05) / 0.30;
    IF rCavitationSpeedDerate < 0.0 THEN rCavitationSpeedDerate := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF rCavitationSpeedDerate > 1.0 THEN rCavitationSpeedDerate := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCavitationSpeedDerate := 1.00;
END_IF;

IF Delta_u1_unc > 0.0 THEN
    Delta_u1_opt := Delta_u1_unc * rCavitationSpeedDerate;
ELSE
    Delta_u1_opt := Delta_u1_unc;
END_IF;
Delta_u2_opt := Delta_u2_unc;

(* Enforce Hard Box Constraints on Actuator Slew Rates *)
IF Delta_u1_opt > c_rDeltaU1_Max THEN
    Delta_u1_opt := c_rDeltaU1_Max;
ELSIF Delta_u1_opt < c_rDeltaU1_Min THEN
    Delta_u1_opt := c_rDeltaU1_Min;
END_IF;

IF Delta_u2_opt > c_rDeltaU2_Max THEN
    Delta_u2_opt := c_rDeltaU2_Max;
ELSIF Delta_u2_opt < c_rDeltaU2_Min THEN
    Delta_u2_opt := c_rDeltaU2_Min;
END_IF;

(* Integrate Actuator Demands *)
IF bSystemRunning THEN
    rVFDFreqDemand_Internal := rVFDFreqDemand_Internal + Delta_u1_opt;
    rChokeDemand_Internal := rChokeDemand_Internal + Delta_u2_opt;
ELSE
    IF iState < 30 THEN
        rVFDFreqDemand_Internal := 0.0;
        rChokeDemand_Internal := 15.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Clamp Actuator Outputs to Physical Hardware Boundaries *)
IF rVFDFreqDemand_Internal > c_rMaxVFD_Hz THEN
    rVFDFreqDemand_Internal := c_rMaxVFD_Hz;
ELSIF rVFDFreqDemand_Internal < c_rMinVFD_Hz THEN
    IF bSystemRunning THEN
        rVFDFreqDemand_Internal := c_rMinVFD_Hz;
    ELSE
        rVFDFreqDemand_Internal := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rChokeDemand_Internal > 100.0 THEN
    rChokeDemand_Internal := 100.0;
ELSIF rChokeDemand_Internal < 5.0 THEN
    rChokeDemand_Internal := 5.0;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 SUPERVISORY FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)                                                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 12-State deterministic operational sequence managing deep-well ESP lifecycle from cold boot,
   barrier fluid charging, hydrostatic equalization, harmonic resonant hop, to nominal run
   and failsafe trip lockout recovery. *)

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: COLD INITIALIZATION & SENSOR SELF-TEST / TMR VALIDATION *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rVFDFrequencyCommand := 0.0;
        rVFDSpeedSetpoint := 0.0;
        rChokeValveCommand := 10.0;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;

        IF (rStateTimerAccum > 2.0) THEN
            IF NOT bSuct_Failed_Total AND NOT bDisc_Failed_Total AND
               NOT bSuctT_Failed_Total AND NOT bMotT_Failed_Total AND
               NOT bBarr_Failed_Total THEN
                rStateTimerAccum := 0.0;
                iState := 10; (* Proceed to Barrier Fluid Pre-Pressurization *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: DIELECTRIC BARRIER FLUID PRE-PRESSURIZATION & SEALS HEALTH CHECK *)
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rStateTimerAccum := rStateTimerAccum + c_rScanTimeSeconds;
